mentions.name: localbq
mentions.description: This project is a BigQuery emulator built from scratch, developed as part of the localgcp effort. It implements GoogleSQL (previously ZetaSQL) behavior and was created to learn how the language works.
mentions.source_excerpt: Part of building this, I decided to build a BigQuery emulator from scratch and learned a lot about GoogleSQL (previously ZetaSQL) along the way: https://github.com/slokam-ai/localbq
